name: Parent-to-Hilbert source measure factor
meaning: Z_H is the common factor relating the parent source measure to the Hilbert stress used in the local EH equation.

name: Common-plus-leak decomposition
meaning: Z_0 is one common normalization; delta_ZH contains time/species/frame/range/environment/readout dependence.

name: Absorb one common source normalization into the measured coupling
equation: kappa_bar = kappa_* Z_0; G_N = c^4 kappa_bar/(8*pi)
meaning: A universal constant factor is locally indistinguishable from the usual calibrated Newton constant.

name: Normalization gauge condition
equation: Z_H -> 1 is allowed iff delta_ZH=0 or all D_A delta_ZH vanish in local tested channels
meaning: Setting Z_H=1 before proving leak silence is a closure assumption, not a derivation.

name: Physical leak residual
equation: D_A ln G_eff = D_A ln kappa_* + D_A delta_ZH
meaning: All local coupling tests see derivatives or differences of the leak, not the absorbed common factor.
